role: Independent arithmetic and quantity check of supplied fictional data only
convention: alpha = [alpha] * l * c, c in g/mL and l in dm
units: degree / (dm * g/mL) = degree * mL / (g * dm); reference values now carry this exact quantity and convention.
uncertaintyBoundary: Only the supplied angular uncertainty is propagated. Path and concentration are held fixed as the task asks; this is not a combined experimental uncertainty, confidence interval, instrument calibration or proof of reference accuracy.
sourceUse: Previously actually read primary textbook relation checks the alpha versus bracket-alpha normalization. Supplied glucose/fructose numbers are fictional task references, not independently measured literature constants.
